news.analysis: Jones almost led the Colts to an upset win over the Cowboys at home, as the Colts were up 23-20 with under two minutes left in the game. His lone touchdown pass went to Ashton Dulin on a 55-yard completion in the third quarter. Jones has thrown just six touchdowns and nine interceptions through nine games in what has been a disappointing season for him. A low-end QB2 in fantasy moving forward, he will take on the Dolphins in Week 10.
news.contents: Daniel Jones completed 20 of 34 passes for 180 yards, one touchdown, and one interception while adding 11 yards on three rushes in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9.
news.title: Daniel Jones throws one TD in Week 9

news.analysis: Jones' paltry production in this one wasn't the result of backfield mate Jordan Mason seeing a surge in touches, as the latter finished with just seven of his own. The Vikings' offense is all out of sorts at the moment, and their RB tandem is suffering as a result. Jones looked like he might have found the Fountain of Youth earlier this season, but over the last three weeks, the veteran has given fantasy managers next to nothing.

news.analysis: Folk went 13-for-18 on field goal attempts. Atlanta signed Jake Moody as the corresponding move.
news.contents: The Falcons released kicker Nick Folk.
news.title: Nick Folk released by Falcons

news.contents: The Atlanta Falcons released veteran kicker Nick Folk on Tuesday, sources told NFL insider Jordan Schultz. In a corresponding move, the Falcons signed kicker Jake Moody off the Baltimore Ravens' practice squad. Folk gets the boot off Atlanta's roster after going 13-for-18 on his field-goal attempts (including going 1-for-4 from 50-plus yards out) and 17-for-18 on his extra-point tries in the first nine games of the 2026 season. The 42-year-old made 96.6% of his 29 field-goal attempts in 16 ...
news.title: Falcons Release Kicker Nick Folk

news.title: Kendre Miller visiting Cowboys

news.contents: Running back Kendre Miller visited the Dallas Cowboys on Tuesday, and according to Joseph Hoyt of The Dallas Morning News, the Cowboys are expected to sign him to the team's practice squad. With Tyler Goodson (knee) expected to miss multiple weeks due to a knee injury, Miller has a chance to immediately play a significant role behind starter Javonte Williams. Williams is currently the only healthy running back listed on Dallas' roster, so Miller has a clear path to the No. 2 role in the running ...

news.contents: Tre' Harris caught 3-of-7 targets for just six yards in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Houston Texans.

The Broncos have called around just in case, but it does not appear that Engram will be joining another team for the second half of the 2026 season. news.contents: The San Francisco 49ers did not release wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk on Tuesday, according to David Lombardi of The San Francisco Standard. Reports suggested that the 49ers were likely to release Aiyuk on Tuesday, but that did not end up happening. Aiyuk does not count for a roster spot during his two-week unpaid roster exemption after the league reinstated him from the left-squad list this week.
